summary: Specifies the Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol, based on the One-way Active Measurement Protocol, for measuring round-trip or two-way network metrics between two devices. OWAMP could be used both ways for one-way metrics but could not handle round trips. TWAMP is standards-track and has been extended later.

eli5.summary: To find how long a ball takes to go to a friend and back, you throw it and time it. TWAMP does that with test packets over a network.

questions: how to measure round trip delay between network devices
